parts.legal_domain: Nonnegative arbitrary int root call_budget; finite forest, each node unique effect UID/nonempty service/positive int attempts. Service identity may repeat along A->B->A but effect nodes do not form object cycles. Every actual node provider has nonempty bool tuple, exhausted script repeats final result. All children are considered in declared order for each parent attempt, even if an earlier sibling failed; only after all settle may own provider run. Success cache is per effect UID in same root context. Each invocation decision or dependency-failed result advances logical tick, not wallclock. No async or external service guarantee. One fresh CascadeIntake and initially unused ScriptedProvider belong to one complete replay; reusing a completed context/provider across separate reports is outside this finite-run API.
